rules.statement: The title to the property passed upon the Vesting Order dated 18.12.1973, not on Agreement P2.
rules.supporting_quote: "I reject the contention that title passed on P2 and I hold that title passed to the Corporation upon the Vesting Order dated 18.12.1973(P5) and not on Agreement P2."

meta.parties: State Graphite Corporation v. K.S.P.D. Fernando and Another
